Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: CMM-601.6: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level
Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft
Required findings: Post‑operative imaging demonstrates malposition or failure of the implant/instrumentation or structural bone graft (e.g., migration, screw breakage or loosening, rod breakage/bending, loss of curve correction, decompensation, etc.)
Medical necessity indications.Source: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level > Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Required findings: ≥ 6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level
Daily neck pain of clinically significant severity causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing)
Physical examination findings concordant with the reported neck pain

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement after BOTH of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs for 6 weeks AND a provider‑directed exercise program for 6 weeks
Post‑operative imaging performed ≥ 6 months after the prior fusion showing pseudoarthrosis at the requested level(s)
Post‑operative MRI/CT findings concordant with symptoms
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder)
Documentation of nicotine‑free status: either never‑smoker or abstinence from all nicotine products for ≥ 6 weeks verified by objective cotinine testing
Medical necessity indications.Source: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level > Unremitting Neck Pain with Pseudoarthrosis

Required findings: ≥ 6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level
Daily pain causing functional impairment AND unremitting radicular pain to the shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

Physical exam demonstrating at least one of: dermatomal sensory deficit, motor weakness (biceps/triceps), reflex changes, positive shoulder abduction relief sign, positive Spurling’s maneuver, or radicular pain without concordant objective findings

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement after at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs for 6 weeks, provider‑directed exercise program for 6 weeks, epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) at the same level
Post‑operative imaging ≥ 6 months after prior fusion showing pseudoarthrosis at the requested level(s)

Post‑operative MRI/CT demonstrating neural structure compression at the requested level(s) concordant with symptoms and exam, caused by herniated disc, synovial/arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, or osteophytes
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Medical necessity indications.Source: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level > Radiculopathy with Pseudoarthrosis

Required findings: ≥ 6 months elapsed since the prior ACDF at the same level

Symptoms of myelopathy such as upper/lower extremity weakness, numbness, pain, fine motor dysfunction (e.g., difficulty buttoning, handwriting), gait disturbance, new‑onset bowel/bladder dysfunction, or frequent falls

Physical exam demonstrating any of: grip‑and‑release test abnormality, ataxic gait, hyperreflexia, Hoffmann sign, Babinski sign, tandem walking ataxia, inverted brachial radial reflex, increased tone/spasticity, clonus, myelopathic hand
Post‑operative imaging ≥ 6 months after prior fusion showing pseudoarthrosis at the requested level(s)
Post‑operative MRI/CT showing findings concordant with symptoms and exam caused by cervical spinal cord compression or cervical spinal stenosis
No unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Documentation of nicotine‑free status as defined above
Medical necessity indications.Source: Repeat Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF) at the Same Level > Myelopathy with Pseudoarthrosis

Non-Indications: Attempted repeat ACDF at the same level performed < 6 months after the prior fusion
Absence of documented pseudoarthrosis on imaging when required

Failure to complete the mandated 6‑week trial of prescription analgesics/NSAIDs and/or a supervised exercise program (or the required two conservative modalities for radiculopathy) unless contraindicated
Presence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder)
Patient who is a current smoker or has used nicotine products within 6 weeks of the planned surgery without objective cotinine verification
Lack of concordance between symptoms, physical exam findings, and imaging evidence of pathology
Malposition or implant failure without radiographic confirmation
Important criteria & exceptions: All required criteria must be met for the specific indication; meeting only a subset does not qualify the procedure
Conservative therapy trial duration is a minimum of six (6) weeks; longer trials are acceptable but not required
For radiculopathy, improvement must be insufficient after at least two of the three specified conservative modalities (medication, exercise, epidural steroid injection/root block)
Nicotine‑free status may be documented by patient self‑report as a never‑smoker or by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range
Mental/behavioral health disorders must be managed; documentation of treatment or resolution is required before surgery
Imaging to confirm pseudoarthrosis or implant failure must be performed no earlier than six (6) months after the index ACDF
Documentation required: Operative report of the prior anterior cervical discectomy and fusion at the same level
Post‑operative plain radiographs, CT, or MRI performed ≥ 6 months after the prior fusion demonstrating pseudoarthrosis or implant malposition/failure
Radiology report describing the specific imaging findings (e.g., migration, screw loosening, loss of correction, pseudoarthrosis, neural compression)
Comprehensive physical examination note documenting symptoms, functional impairment, and objective neurologic findings relevant to the indication
Medication trial documentation confirming prescription‑strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs prescribed for at least six (6) weeks and patient adherence
Physical therapy, chiropractic, or other supervised exercise program records showing a minimum six (6)‑week course
Epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block procedure reports (for radiculopathy indication) confirming level and date
Mental health assessment note confirming absence of unmanaged significant psychiatric or substance‑use disorders, or documentation of treatment plan if present

Nicotine‑free verification: either a signed statement of never‑smoker status or objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal limits performed within six (6) weeks prior to surgery
Any additional imaging (MRI/CT) demonstrating concordant neural compression or spinal cord stenosis for radiculopathy or myelopathy indications
